description:
Standard self-serve rates in USD per second of generated video.

- Without video input: 480p: $0.1177; 720p: $0.2647; 1080p: $0.6518.
- With video input: 480p: $0.1387; 720p: $0.3264; 1080p: $0.7858.

Total price = selected rate × output duration in seconds. Input video duration is not added to the billed duration. Image or audio references alone use the rate without video input.
